visualCharacteristics.purpose: Contact/phone table: bold header row with a dark rule, thin grey rules between rows, no fill or stripes.
visualCharacteristics.description: Real table, 20px/28px sans text, first column one third wide. Header row bold with a 1px dark rule under it, body rows separated by 1px #d6d6d6 rules, 16px vertical cell padding, links underlined blue. Several paragraphs in one cell stack with the same grey rule between them. Scrolls horizontally if it cannot fit.

contentPattern.structure: Row 1: header cells (Contact | Number). Each later row: label or linked label | phone link(s) with notes; several numbers for one contact = several paragraphs in one cell.
contentPattern.description: First row becomes the column headers (th scope=col), the first cell of each body row is a row header (th scope=row). Source rowspan cells are folded into one row with one paragraph per number.
contentPattern.blockContent: Contact table for Mayo Clinic Arizona: General number, Appointment Office, Billing and Insurance (two numbers), International Center, ...
table: Phone link(s) + note; one paragraph per number

reuseGuidance: Use for two-column label/value lists such as phone directories. First row is the header row. Put several values for one label as separate paragraphs in one cell rather than splitting rows.
